english.title: Knowingly / recklessly provide false statement in response to a notice under section 53(1) of the Land Drainage Act 1991
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) being the owner of an hereditament namely, **(..SPECIFY HEREDITAMENT..), upon whom a notice had been served under section 53(1) of the Land Drainage Act 1991 dated **(..SPECIFY DATE..), which required you to state in writing the name and address of any person known to you as being an occupier of that hereditament, knowingly or recklessly made a statement in respect of that information, which was false in a material particular namely **(..SPECIFY FALSE STATEMENT..)
english.legislation: Contrary to section 53(2)(b) and (3) of the Land Drainage Act 1991.
